draft.emotion: waiting in line with a stack of envelopes, slightly impatient
notes: For the building, use the preposition 'на': на почте (at the post office), идти на почту (to go to the post office).
In the senses 'mail' and 'email', 'почта' is uncountable and has no plural.
For email, 'почта' is standard in everyday speech; the full term is 'электронная почта'.
